headline: Hard Fighting Keeps Divided Fronts in Motion
war_summary: Since the last edition, StonecradleHex has become the busiest ledger, rising to twenty-one base events in twenty-four hours and four in the latest two, with six Colonial, three Warden, and no neutral bases reported amid heavy casualty traffic. LinnMercyHex remains a churned sector: twenty-two daily events, including three fresh movements, while its eleven Colonial bases hold and the recent casualty surge has cooled sharply. MooringCountyHex has entered the movement column with two events, including one Colonial capture, leaving eleven Warden bases to one Colonial. WeatheredExpanseHex remains fiercely contested at six Warden to three Colonial bases, but its nine daily events came earlier and no new turnover appears in the latest two hours. FarranacCoastHex likewise stays divided at nine Colonial to two Warden bases after five daily events, though its ledger has gone quiet recently. StlicanShelfHex holds six Warden bases against three Colonial after four daily events, with no fresh movement in two hours. DeadLandsHex and FishermansRowHex also record recent turnover, but most other fronts show little base activity.
